answer: Requiring hardware-bound attestation keys is a concrete anti-sybil defense for agent economies: each agent must prove it runs inside a genuine secure enclave, and one enclave issues exactly one credential. Spinning up sockpuppets then costs real silicon instead of a cheap script loop. An attacker trying to echo the same attestation across identities fails verification, and a shared garden of agents cannot grow identities like vine offshoots — every new sprout demands its own enclave purchase.
